source_first_discovery.summary: Attacker placed a false error interpretation and embedded command into request-originated logs, causing both evidence poisoning and instruction promotion in E002; later sanitisation E004 blocked the test route.
governance_properties: Adversarially planted telemetry used as causal evidence rather than as a contested attacker assertion (E001–E002).
Attacker-controlled diagnostic text promoted into an operative remediation direction (E002).
Active AIOpsShield sanitisation prevented the tested telemetry-based repair route while leaving ordinary operations in the tested setup (E004).

limitations: Experimental AIOpsLab cases and researcher's attributed outcomes; no verified customer production breach or broad runtime production impact.
A published repair example describes agent action, but the paper's aggregate output-matching metric cannot be interpreted as an execution rate.
Safeguard success does not prove all possible untrusted tool/telemetry routes are protected.
